name: 22206 · Arlington, VA
findings: ZIP 22206 (Arlington) has 82 nonprofit organizations. 44 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 36 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22206 (Arlington) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 22206 (Arlington) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 62% of the typical level).
